issues.title: Ingest Calhoun County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $7,825,632 across 23 funds. The largest: County General ($2,906,219), County Road Fund ($1,974,038), Solidwaste Fund ($1,197,815). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
